reason: Renames build output extensions from .prod.js to .min.js across many modules/themes and updates ResourceManagementOptionsConfiguration.cs references plus a bootstrap-select dependency change from 'bootstrap' to 'admin', so any external theme/module referencing the old .prod.js filenames or resource names will break after this widespread convention change.
